title: Retirement Share at Account Closing by Seller Performance Standing Level
content:
**Share.** The retirement share is the top-level retirement share of 1 (100%) for a seller placed at Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level with at most three policy violations recorded in the last twelve whole calendar months, and the mid-level retirement share of 0.75 (75%) for a seller placed at Standard Level or Above Standard Level with at most three policy violations recorded in that period. A seller placed at a lower level, or with four or more policy violations recorded in that period, takes neither of these shares.

The share applies to the points retired when a seller closes the selling account under Seller Performance Standing. For closure, whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the closing date: a violation lies in the last twelve whole calendar months when fewer than twelve whole months have passed from its recording date to the closing date. Violations of every type count.

## Schedule

| Level placed at | Violations recorded in the last twelve whole calendar months | Retirement share |
|---|---|---|
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | 0 to 3 | 1 |
| Standard Level or Above Standard Level | 0 to 3 | 0.75 |
| Top Rated, Preferred Partner, Standard or Above Standard Level | 4 or more | neither share above |
| Developing Seller Level or Below Standard Level | any | neither share above |

## On the boundary (hypothetical sellers)

- Preferred Partner Level, three violations in the period: 1. Four violations: neither 1 nor 0.75.
- Above Standard Level, three violations in the period: 0.75.
- Retirement basis of 6 points: multiplied by 1 it gives 6.0000; multiplied by 0.75 it gives 4.5000, rounded down to 4.
